Toy samples, one per contracted table. Values are made up (data_version `toy`); they exist so
both sides can build against the contract before the real data exists. District ids are real Census
2011 codes (595 Ernakulam, 598 Alappuzha, 599 Pathanamthitta, 381 Cuttack, 386 Khordha, 387 Puri). Geometry is WKT
boxes, not real boundaries.
